'''''Tejha Larel''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Cjaalysce]], a colonist on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The name "Tejha Larel" is [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Old Corellian]] for "Undying Love." It was a painting that showed her grief after her lover, [[Iann Doaba]], exiled himself into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. [[Pret Swain]]'s [[Parent/Legends|father]] came into possession of this painting, and passed it onto [[Benoni Ulte]]. Iann Doaba's spirit clung to the painting, and his shadow could be observed haunting it.
